jobs.title: Director, Merchandising
jobs.description:
Knix is an award-winning intimate apparel and activewear brand that is re-inventing intimates for real life. Through our innovative products and our engaged community, we are empowering people everywhere to be unapologetically free. Launched in 2013, we are one of the fastest-growing intimate apparel brands in North America and are globally recognized as an innovator within the apparel space. We reach over 3 million customers through our online stores, Knix retail locations across North America and channels such as wholesale and Amazon. We are revolutionizing the apparel industry with our best-in-class customer experience, innovative products and brands Knix, Kt by Knix, and Mntd. Come join us if you are looking for a purpose-driven and authentic career!

Knix is looking for a Director, Merchandising to lead the merchandising strategy and business across our three brands: Knix, Kt by Knix and MNTD.

Reporting to the VP, Merchandising, Planning & Allocations, this role will lead merchandising across Wholesale, Retail, E-commerce and Amazon, with responsibility for driving sales, margin, inventory and overall business performance.

We are looking for a strong merchant and business leader who can balance the day-to-day needs of the business with a clear view of where we need to go next. This person will identify opportunities across categories, channels and brands, build assortments that meet customer needs, and make decisions based on both data and strong merchant instinct.

The Director will work closely with Product, Brand, Marketing, Planning & Allocations, Retail, Wholesale and E-commerce to ensure we have the right product, in the right channel, at the right time.

About You

You are an experienced merchandising leader with 7+ years of experience, ideally in DTC, apparel or intimate apparel.
You have experience leading a business across multiple channels and understand the differences between Wholesale, Retail, E-commerce and Amazon.
You think like a business owner and understand the connection between sales, margin, inventory and profitability.
You are equally comfortable looking at the big picture and getting into the details of a category, style, channel or business issue.
You use data to make decisions, but don't rely on data alone. You bring strong customer and merchant intuition to the business.
You are able to spot trends, identify whitespace and turn opportunities into action.
You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change.
You are a strong people leader who knows how to build, develop and retain a high-performing team.
You build strong relationships across functions and are comfortable influencing decisions outside of your immediate team.
You have a strong understanding of the customer and a genuine interest in the Knix brands.

The Opportunity

Business & Merchandising

Lead the merchandising strategy and business across Knix, Kt by Knix and MNTD, with accountability for sales, margin, inventory and profitability.
Develop annual and seasonal strategies, including category priorities, assortment plans, pricing and product flow.
Use sales, customer and market data to identify risks, opportunities and whitespace, and turn those insights into clear business actions.
Partner with Planning & Allocations to manage inventory investment, receipts and in-season opportunities.
Identify new categories, products, channels and other opportunities to drive future growth.
Build differentiated assortments that reflect the customer, positioning and commercial needs of each brand.

Channel & Product

Lead merchandising across Wholesale, Retail, E-commerce and Amazon, adapting assortments and strategies to the needs of each channel.
Partner with Product and Brand to shape the product roadmap and ensure the assortment supports both customer needs and business goals.
Work with Wholesale and Retail on channel and seasonal strategies, and with E-commerce and Amazon on digital assortment, launches and productivity.
Support strategic collaborations and product initiatives that strengthen brand differentiation and drive growth.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

Lead, develop and retain a high-performing Merchandising team, setting clear priorities and expectations.
Work closely with Product, Brand, Marketing, Planning & Allocations, Finance, Retail, Wholesale and E-commerce to align on business and product priorities.
Bring a strong merchandising perspective to business decisions and ensure teams are aligned on assortment, launches and seasonal priorities.
Create a team culture that encourages strong merchant thinking, accountability, testing and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

7+ years of merchandising experience with increasing leadership responsibility.
Experience in a high-growth DTC or omnichannel business is strongly preferred.
Apparel or intimate apparel experience is an asset.
Experience across multiple channels, including E-commerce and a combination of Retail, Wholesale and/or Amazon.
Strong understanding of assortment planning, category management, pricing, margin, inventory, forecasting and in-season management.
Strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to understand and manage a P&L or significant portion of the business.
Proven experience building and leading high-performing teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence decisions across the organization.
Comfortable working at both a strategic and detailed level.
Able to operate effectively in a fast-paced business with changing priorities.
Strong customer focus and a clear point of view on product and merchandising.

Salary

Annual salary starting at $135,000 CAD

Compensation & Care

Transparency is at the heart of everything we do, including how we pay. The posted expected hourly rate for this role represents candidates developing new skills within the position. Increased rates represent those who are more proficient or have achieved mastery and deep institutional knowledge over time.

Rewards are not just about your regular pay and monthly bonuses. We believe rewards should support your whole life, not just your shift. That’s why for permanent full-time employees
, we cover 100% of the premiums for extended health and dental plans from your first day. You’ll also gain access to mental health support through our Employee Assistance Programs through our partners at Dialogue who provide virtual coaching, therapy, and counseling.

When your family grows, we’re there for you. Our Paid Parental Leave plan tops up salary to 80%
for eligible permanent, full-time employees. We also invest in your future with a RRSP matching program
for permanent full-time team members. Plus, you’ll enjoy a 50% discount
on Knix products because we want you to love what you sell.

AI Disclosure Statement

We want to share that we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help us screen and assess applications. While technology helps us stay organized, every hiring decision at Knix is made by real people who care about finding the best addition to our team. We use these tools to support our process, not to replace the human connection that makes our culture special.

How We Hire

Our people are what make Knix, Knix! Our people are passionate and have a strong belief in our mission. Our people are naturally curious and ambitious by nature. Employees feel respected and supported at Knix. We take an inclusive and equitable approach offering the same interview experience to every candidate we meet with. Knix is an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate everyone and their intersecting identities. We know and believe that diverse and inclusive teams empower us to make better decisions and inspire innovation so that we can better serve our customers and community. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out! We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time
